frozen_candidate_root_contribution: Tmn (attested only as Form XII: iṭmaʾanna / taṭmaʾinnu / muṭmaʾinn-) = a locus (heart, soul, person, place, being) coming into or being in a settled, at-rest condition in which a prior or potential agitation — fear, doubt, or instability/precariousness — is stilled, so that the locus rests firmly, characteristically settling upon (بِ) a ground. The verb is valence-neutral: the moral color and the specific agitation removed are supplied entirely by context/subject/object, not by the root.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: Tmn (attested only as Form XII: iṭmaʾanna / taṭmaʾinnu / muṭmaʾinn-) = a locus (heart, soul, person, place, being) coming into or being in a settled, at-rest condition in which a prior or potential agitation — fear, doubt, or instability/precariousness — is stilled, so that the locus rests firmly, characteristically settling upon (بِ) a ground. The verb is valence-neutral: the moral color and the specific agitation removed are supplied entirely by context/subject/object, not by the root.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The word describes something that could waver, tip, or be disturbed coming to rest and holding steady. A heart stops churning with doubt or fear and settles; a person settles contentedly onto something; a town or people dwell settled and at ease; a soul is at peace. What settles it, and whether that settling is praiseworthy or blameworthy, comes from what it settles upon (God's remembrance and faith in some verses, the worldly life in others), not from the word itself.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Tmn does NOT entail: (1) moral positivity — 10:7 (وَٱطْمَأَنُّوا۟ بِهَا, paired with رَضُوا, condemned) and 22:11 (ٱطْمَأَنَّ بِهِۦ, the ʿalā-ḥarf worshipper who bolts at trial) apply it to blameworthy/fickle settling; (2) safety/amn — 16:112 coordinates مُّطْمَئِنَّةً with ءَامِنَةً as two distinct qualities; (3) approval/riḍā — 10:7 coordinates ٱطْمَأَنُّوا۟ with رَضُوا, hence distinct; (4) knowledge/certainty — 5:113 lists وَتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُنَا separately from وَنَعْلَمَ, and 2:260 has Ibrahim already believing (بَلَىٰ) yet still seeking لِّيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِى; (5) bodily stillness/immobility — 17:95 has the settled ones يَمْشُونَ (walking); (6) permanence — 22:11's settled worshipper overturns at the next trial.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 17:95:8:1 (يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ): a settledness that is not epistemic (no doubt to dispel), not cessation of any stated prior fear (angels), and not contentment-upon-a-بِ-object — it denotes a settled, at-home mode of inhabiting the earth. Folding it under the heart-reassurance nucleus requires retreat to the maximally broad gloss 'settledness,' and at that breadth Tmn's contribution stops being distinguishable from Amn (dwelling securely). This, together with 16:112's active pairing ءَامِنَةً مُّطْمَئِنَّةً (which undercuts distinctiveness from amn in the security sense), is the material resistance that caps the nucleus below STRONG.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A two-class reading that declines to bridge: (INNER) settling of the heart/soul, often بِ-grounded, contrast = doubt/fickleness/coercion (10:7, 13:28×2, 16:106, 2:260, 3:126, 5:113, 8:10, 22:11, 89:27); and (OUTER) settled security/dwelling of community/place/inhabitants, no بِ, contrast = external danger (4:103, 16:112, 17:95), where the outer sense is not distinctively separable from Amn (16:112). On this account the link between the two is a breadth-abstraction not sharply demonstrated Quran-internally, and two REPRESENTATIVE classes are preferred to one unified nucleus. It is not adopted as the result because the settled-vs-unsettled spine IS text-attested (4:103 fear-state→secure; 22:11 حَرْف/inqalaba↔iṭmaʾanna; 16:106 coercion↔heart-at-rest) and the recurrent بِ-grounding genuinely connects the classes — but it is preserved as a live minority reading with 17:95:8:1 as its pivot.

internal_discovery.rationale: All 13 tokens are Form XII with no Form I or other derivation anywhere in the packet, so morphology carries zero differentiating signal and 'root nucleus' is strictly a single lexicalized/derivational family — an inherent scope cap (claim_scope_kind=DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY, claim_scope=REPRESENTATIVE; UNIVERSAL/ROOT_GENERALIZATION is unavailable with no cross-form triangulation). The three lenses converge on one valence-neutral 'settling into an at-rest condition' nucleus and all decline to fragment to UNRESOLVED, because the settled-vs-unsettled contrast (4:103, 22:11, 16:106) and the recurrent بِ-ground supply a real internal bridge. However, a coherent resistant outer sub-class (4:103, 16:112, 17:95) exists whose bridge to the inner class is a breadth-abstraction and whose security sense is not distinctively separable from amn (16:112 pairs āmina + muṭmaʾinna), and the root is demonstrably morally neutral (10:7, 22:11). Under the contract, material resistance plus a coherent resistant sub-class caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE; this is also the honest reconciliation of Analyst A's STRONG claim against B's and C's MODERATE.

clusters.classification_rationale: Dominant, most prototypical use; subject is قلوب/نفس. Settling is affective repose distinct from belief/knowledge (2:260 بَلَىٰ + لِّيَطْمَئِنَّ; 5:113 وَتَطْمَئِنَّ ... وَنَعْلَمَ separately). 89:27's ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ is the same participial state, not a separate lexicalization.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Six of these settle upon or with a named ground; the shared frame (locus + optional بِ-ground) is the strongest internal evidence for one nucleus.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: A person settles contentedly upon a بِ-object — the same coming-to-rest, but here directed at the worldly life (10:7, بِهَا) or at good fortune (22:11, بِهِ) and morally condemned/fickle.
clusters.classification_rationale: Consistent with the valence-neutral nucleus while serving as decisive counterevidence to any positive-valence ('tranquility of faith') gloss. 22:11 also supplies the settled-vs-precarious spine: عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍ / ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ opposed to ٱطْمَأَنَّ.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Same verb + بِ-ground frame as the inner cluster; valence flips entirely with the object, confirming the root supplies settling, not evaluation.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Situational/collective settled security or settled dwelling: being secure again after danger (4:103), a settled undisturbed town (16:112), beings dwelling/walking at ease (17:95). No heart, no doubt, no بِ-ground.
clusters.classification_rationale: Covered by the broad nucleus only at a breadth ('settledness') where Tmn stops being distinguishable from Amn — 16:112 actively coordinates مُّطْمَئِنَّةً with ءَامِنَةً (non-distinctiveness), and 17:95 combines settledness with locomotion and has no agitation-to-still and no بِ-object. This is a coherent resistant sub-class whose bridge to the inner class is a breadth-abstraction, not a sharply demonstrated Quran-internal mechanism.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 4:103's contrast with the preceding fear/travel state (قِيَٰمًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِكُمْ → فَإِذَا ٱطْمَأْنَنتُمْ) does connect it to the settled-vs-unsettled spine, which is why the whole root is not UNRESOLVED; but distinctiveness from amn is not established here.

reconciliation.rationale: Adopted Adversary C's material-resistance finding: bare post-danger security with no heart/doubt/بِ-object forces the abstraction and blurs distinctiveness from amn; recorded as a resistant seam that caps strength at MODERATE rather than being erased.

The ءَامِنَةً مُّطْمَئِنَّةً coordination is genuine Quran-internal evidence that Tmn is not distinctively its own in the security sense; distinctiveness_ok fails here, so the token is flagged rather than counted as clean support.
Kept as the pivot of the preserved two-class minority reading; it resists any narrow (non-breadth) account, which is the honest ground for MODERATE over STRONG.

candidate_root_contribution: Tmn (attested only as Form XII: iṭmaʾanna / taṭmaʾinnu / muṭmaʾinn-) = a locus (heart, soul, person, place, being) coming into or being in a settled, at-rest condition in which a prior or potential agitation — fear, doubt, or instability/precariousness — is stilled, so that the locus rests firmly, characteristically settling upon (بِ) a ground. The verb is valence-neutral: the moral color and the specific agitation removed are supplied entirely by context/subject/object, not by the root.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 13 confirmed occurrences, all Form XII (9 V, 3 N, 1 ADJ), verse_text from Tanzil and morphology from QAC 0.4; distribution across ~9 suras and multiple context types (heart/soul, person+object, town, angels, post-danger community).
layer_attribution.derivation: Uniformly Form XII (iṭmaʾanna / taṭmaʾinnu / muṭmaʾinn-); no Form I or other stem attested, so root-vs-form cannot be separated internally and the account is strictly of the root as realized in this one derivational family.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: The N(XII) participles (16:106, 16:112, 17:95) and ADJ(XII) (89:27) are the transparent stative/resultative of the same Form XII verb, not an independent lexicalized sub-class; the syntactic POS split carries no semantic divergence.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Contextual/narrative content — dhikr, faith, glad tidings of victory, worldly life, Ibrahim's request, the coerced believer, the fickle worshipper, the punished town, the eschatological soul — supplies the specific agitation stilled and the moral valence, but is NOT elevated into the root claim; the root contributes only valence-neutral coming-to-rest.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Analyst A's STRONG/COMPREHENSIVE was reconciled against B's and C's MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE by adopting the mono-form scope cap and C's coherent resistant outer cluster (4:103, 16:112, 17:95) plus 16:112 amn non-distinctiveness; three outer tokens moved preliminary CONSISTENT → final RESISTANT, yielding MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE while preserving the single nucleus (not fragmenting to UNRESOLVED).
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: A coherent outer settled-security/dwelling sub-class persists as a resistant seam whose bridge to the inner class is a breadth-abstraction and whose security sense is not distinctively separable from amn (17:95 the pivot; 16:112 the distinctiveness failure); the two-class reading is preserved as a live minority result.

hard_cases.reason: Settledness with locomotion (يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ), no agitation-to-still, no بِ-ground; only a breadth-abstraction covers it, at which point Tmn is not distinguishable from amn.

hard_case_representation.rationale: A coherent outer sub-class (4:103, 16:112, 17:95) persists as a resistant seam whose bridge to the inner class is a breadth-abstraction and whose security sense is not distinctively separable from amn; plus an adversarial valence boundary (10:7). The core nucleus holds (research_state=PREFERRED) but the resistance is genuine and material, so it is represented rather than dissolved, capping the result at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: If the outer cluster (4:103, 16:112, 17:95) is shown Quran-internally to be a separate sense with no demonstrated bridge to the inner heart/soul settling — i.e. the settled-vs-unsettled contrast and بِ-ground frame do NOT in fact connect them — then the single-nucleus partition collapses and the honest output is an UNRESOLVED multi-class (two REPRESENTATIVE classes) rather than one preferred nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: Compare 4:103:11:1, 16:112:7:1, 17:95:8:1 against the inner cluster (13:28×2, 2:260, 5:113, 3:126, 8:10, 16:106, 89:27) and the object-settling pair (10:7, 22:11), checking for any shared contrast/collocation that is NOT a mere breadth-abstraction.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Test whether each outer token participates in the same settled-vs-unsettled opposition attested for the inner class (4:103's prior fear-state; 22:11's حَرْف/inqalaba; 16:106's coercion) and whether the بِ-ground frame or an equivalent internal mechanism recurs; if only the vague gloss 'settledness' unites them, treat the bridge as unproven.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not let the 8:5 numerical dominance of the inner class, the shared Form-XII morphology, or any external lexicon assume unity; morphology carries no differentiating signal here and same-form ≠ one sense. Control for 16:112's amn-coordination so 'security' is not silently smuggled in as Tmn's own contribution.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If the bridge fails, downgrade research_state to UNRESOLVED, set result_strength=UNRESOLVED, claim_scope=LOCAL, claim_scope_kind=UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY, null the candidate_root_contribution, and record the inner and outer classes as an unbridged partition.

reopen_conditions: If any Form I or non-Form-XII derivation of ط م ن is ever confirmed in the corpus, reopen: the DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY scope cap and the 'root nucleus = single lexicalized family' caveat would need re-evaluation against cross-form evidence.

If a Quran-internal mechanism is found that distinctively separates the outer settled-security tokens (4:103, 16:112, 17:95) from amn — beyond the breadth gloss 'settledness' — reopen to consider upgrading toward STRONG; conversely, if 17:95's يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ or 16:112's amn-coordination is judged to sever the bridge, reopen toward an UNRESOLVED two-class partition.

If the valence-neutrality anchor is challenged — e.g. a reading that recategorizes 10:7 or 22:11 as non-blameworthy — reopen the semantic_boundary claim that value is object-supplied rather than root-supplied.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: A full adversarial refutation was not completed to PASSED because distinctiveness from amn is not clean (16:112 coordinates āmina + muṭmaʾinna) and the outer cluster resists a narrow account (17:95). The nucleus nevertheless survives via the text-attested settled-vs-unsettled spine and بِ-ground frame, so per contract the correct status is NOT_RUN with the resisting occurrences recorded, not PASSED and not FAILED.
